source.content: public class ProcessPluginContractsProbe implements Process.Plugin { public Process.PluginDescribeResult describe() { Process.PluginDescribeResult result = new Process.PluginDescribeResult(); result.name = 'Trail Plugin'; result.description = 'Local contract'; Process.PluginDescribeResult.InputParameter input = new Process.PluginDescribeResult.InputParameter('recordId', 'Record Id', Process.PluginDescribeResult.ParameterType.STRING, true); Process.PluginDescribeResult.OutputParameter output = new Process.PluginDescribeResult.OutputParameter('message', 'Message', Process.PluginDescribeResult.ParameterType.STRING); result.inputParameters = new List<Process.PluginDescribeResult.InputParameter>{ input }; result.outputParameters = new List<Process.PluginDescribeResult.OutputParameter>{ output }; return result; } public Process.PluginResult invoke(Process.PluginRequest request) { return new Process.PluginResult('message', request.inputParameters.get('recordId')); } }
